selection_policy: Twenty FATE-M textbook-level statements with compact, standard-Mathlib formalizations, chosen to cover groups, homomorphisms, rings, ideals, fields, integers, complex numbers, subgroups, and cosets while avoiding FATE-H/FATE-X difficulty.

difficulty_protocol.name: direct_target
difficulty_protocol.description: The target is provided directly; redundant true context grows with rank.

difficulty_protocol.name: packed_target
difficulty_protocol.description: The target is the final component of an increasingly deep conjunction.

difficulty_protocol.name: implication_chain
difficulty_protocol.description: The target follows after applying an increasingly long implication chain to supplied facts.

difficulty_protocol.name: disjunction_elimination
difficulty_protocol.description: The target must be recovered from a disjunction with an increasing number of impossible branches.

difficulty_protocol.name: iff_bridge
difficulty_protocol.description: The target is reached by traversing an increasingly long chain of equivalences.

difficulty_protocol.name: unscaffolded
difficulty_protocol.description: No proof of the FATE target is supplied; rank 176 is the original target, and later ranks add true conjunctive obligations.
